observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && for f in $(grep -rl "abliterated:thinking" /var/openhands/conversations/8b55afd6*/events/ 2>/dev/null); do echo "=== $f ==="; python3 - "$f" <<'PY'
import json,sys,re
d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
s=json.dumps(d)
for m in re.finditer(r'"api_key"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"',s):
    v=m.group(1); print("  api_key mentah:",v[:70],f"(len {len(v)})")
for m in re.finditer(r'(sk-obs1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4,})',s):
    print("  DITEMUKAN key:",m.group(1)[:30],"len",len(m.group(1)))
PY
done 2>/dev/null | head -30
